name: claude-code-plugins-plus-skills
tagline_zh: 三千技能一键装，从写代码到订披萨。别家要翻几十页，这里ccpi敲一下，连冷门插件都秒到手。
tagline_en: 3,069 skills, one command. Skip the endless browsing—ccpi fetches even the obscure ones instantly.
desc_en: 471 plugins, 3,069 skills, 347 agents for Claude Code. Open-source marketplace at tonsofskills.com with the ccpi CLI package manager.
why_zh: 不是列表，是活市场。ccpi包管理器让安装像pip一样自然，冷门技能也能精准命中。
why_en: Not a static list—a live marketplace. ccpi makes installing as natural as pip, even for niche skills.
